Subject: Vendor chain transparency + HIPAA scoping for planned integration

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed. As we move into a legal/compliance review for the planned integration, our security and procurement teams need a clearer view of Redwood's downstream vendor landscape and whether any of your subprocessors will process PHI in support of our workflow.

Can you please provide:
- A current subprocessor roster that lists vendor name, country of operation, subprocessed function, and whether the vendor may have access to PHI (yes/no).
- Any DPIA or scoping note you have that specifically addresses HIPAA applicability for customers in the U.S.
- Copies or references to executed SCCs (if any) and whether you anticipate any onward transfer to non-US/non-EEA processors.

We would like to get this into our legal review by end of week. If there's a short template or a secure folder you prefer for evidence exchange, let us know and we'll use that.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Garcia
Head of Integrations
MedGate Health
